AUS.name: Australia
AUS.note: The six states and three mainland territories. Natural Earth draws Lord Howe Island and Macquarie Island as units of their own; they are part of New South Wales and Tasmania.

AZE.name: Azerbaijan
AZE.note: The 14 economic regions of the 2021 reform instead of 78 districts; Nakhchivan is one of them. Composition from the presidential decree of 7 July 2021.

BEL.name: Belgium
BEL.note: Provinces and Brussels. More Detailed: the 43 arrondissements.

BHS.name: Bahamas
BHS.note: One unit: 30 districts across 13,900 km² of land are specks at world scale.

CPV.name: Cape Verde
CPV.note: The Barlavento and Sotavento island groups instead of 22 municipalities.

CZE.name: Czechia
CZE.note: The 14 regions (kraje). More Detailed: the 77 districts (okresy).

DEU.name: Germany
DEU.note: The 16 Länder are too coarse beside their neighbours: Bavaria alone is the size of Ireland. The Regierungsbezirke (NUTS 2) are the next level down — Upper Bavaria, the three Franconias, Swabia, Weser-Ems — and are real historical regions. Länder without districts are one region. More Detailed uses the 400 Kreise.

ESP.name: Spain
ESP.note: The 50 provinces and the two autonomous cities; each can be selected by autonomous community.

FRA.name: France
FRA.note: Departments, as they are. More Detailed divides them into arrondissements.

GBR.name: United Kingdom
GBR.note: Natural Earth draws 232 local authorities, down to London boroughs. The curated map uses the constituent countries and England’s nine regions (ITL 1). More Detailed uses counties and unitary authorities, with Greater London and the six metropolitan counties whole; Maximum is every local authority.

GIN.name: Guinea
GIN.note: The seven regions and Conakry instead of 34 prefectures.

HUN.name: Hungary
HUN.note: The 19 counties and Budapest. Natural Earth draws the 23 cities with county rights as holes in their counties; each is joined to the county around it.

IND.name: India
IND.note: States and union territories, current since 2020.

IRL.name: Ireland
IRL.note: The 26 traditional counties. Natural Earth splits Dublin into four councils and Cork, Galway, Limerick, Waterford and Tipperary into city and county; they are joined again.

ITA.name: Italy
ITA.note: Provinces; each can be selected by region.

JAM.name: Jamaica
JAM.note: Jamaica’s three historic counties instead of 14 parishes.

KEN.name: Kenya
KEN.note: The 47 counties of the 2010 constitution. Natural Earth still draws the 8 provinces they replaced in 2013.

LKA.name: Sri Lanka
LKA.note: The nine provinces instead of 25 districts.

LVA.name: Latvia
LVA.note: Natural Earth draws the 119 municipalities of 2009-2021. The curated map uses the six statistical regions — Riga, Pierīga, Vidzeme, Kurzeme, Zemgale, Latgale — which carry the historical lands. More Detailed uses the 43 municipalities of the 2021 reform.

MDA.name: Moldova
MDA.note: The development regions — North, Centre, South — with Chișinău, Gagauzia and the left bank of the Dniester, instead of 40 districts. Natural Earth files Bender with the left-bank units and does not separate the government-controlled part of Dubăsari.

MKD.name: North Macedonia
MKD.note: The eight statistical regions instead of 84 municipalities.

MLT.name: Malta
MLT.note: Malta and Gozo (NUTS 3) instead of 68 local councils.

MNE.name: Montenegro
MNE.note: Montenegro’s three statistical regions instead of 21 municipalities.

MUS.name: Mauritius
MUS.note: Mauritius, Rodrigues and Agaléga, which lie hundreds of kilometres apart.

MWI.name: Malawi
MWI.note: The three regions instead of 28 districts.
notes: MWI: regions: MWI-1194 (Chitipa) lies in no geoBoundaries MWI ADM1 unit; given to the nearest, Northern Region
MWI: regions: MWI-1873 (Chitipa) lies in no geoBoundaries MWI ADM1 unit; given to the nearest, Northern Region
MWI: regions: MWI-1910 (Mangochi) lies in no geoBoundaries MWI ADM1 unit; given to the nearest, Southern Region

NPL.name: Nepal
NPL.note: The seven provinces of the 2015 constitution. Natural Earth still draws the 14 zones they replaced.

PAK.name: Pakistan
PAK.note: The Federally Administered Tribal Areas joined Khyber Pakhtunkhwa in 2018.

PHL.name: Philippines
PHL.note: The 17 regions instead of 118 provinces and highly urbanised cities.
notes: PHL: regions: PHL-2566 (Laguna) lies in no geoBoundaries PHL ADM1 unit; given to the nearest, Calabarzon
PHL: regions: PHL-2572 (Quezon) lies in no geoBoundaries PHL ADM1 unit; given to the nearest, Calabarzon
PHL: regions: PHL-5557 (Muntinlupa) lies in no geoBoundaries PHL ADM1 unit; given to the nearest, NCR
PHL: regions: PHL-5558 (Taguig City) lies in no geoBoundaries PHL ADM1 unit; given to the nearest, NCR

ROU.name: Romania
ROU.note: The 41 counties and Bucharest. Each can be selected by development region, and by historical region as the counties approximate them.

SHN.name: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha

SVN.name: Slovenia
SVN.note: Natural Earth draws Slovenia’s 193 municipalities, which average 100 km². The 12 statistical regions (NUTS 3) are the division Slovenia itself reports by.

TTO.name: Trinidad and Tobago
TTO.note: Trinidad and Tobago as its two islands.

UGA.name: Uganda
UGA.note: The four regions instead of 112 districts.

UKR.name: Ukraine
UKR.note: Oblasts, as they are, except Odesa Oblast, divided along the Dniester and its estuary, which all but reaches Moldova. South of that water is the Budjak, the southern end of historical Bessarabia (part of Moldavia until 1812): a region of its own here, made of the nine raions that lie there in geoBoundaries' raion layer (2006 boundaries). The rest of the oblast keeps its Natural Earth id.

VNM.name: Vietnam
VNM.note: The 34 provincial units in force since 1 July 2025 (Resolution 202/2025/QH15): 23 formed by merging whole provinces, 11 unchanged. Maximum shows the 63 before it.

XKX.name: Kosovo
XKX.note: The seven districts instead of 30 municipalities.
